title: Harrier Trail Running — Dragon's Back Race 2026 stories: podiums, terrain and shorter formats
claims: Women's podium: Isobel Turner won in 67:46:19, Jacqueline Lee second in 70:02:40, Sarah Ingram third in 71:16:48; favourite Bethan Logan led from Day 1 but dropped on Day 5 after needing rescue off the mountain.
Men's podium: Danny Smith first in 46:59:52, Matt Hammerton second in 50:39:42, Alastair Graves third in 52:56:33.
The article describes 152 full-course starters, of whom 53 completed the full course; 63 Hatchlings finished, 15 of them women.

The terrain spans slate trails, rocky ridges, dry mountain tops, grassy valleys, boggy sections and flatter racing ground, passing the top of Eryri (Yr Wyddfa/Snowdon), the Crib Goch ridge, Elan Valley and the Black Mountains.

Dragon's Fire covered Day 1 (50 km, 4,100 m, Carneddau/Glyderau/Snowdon massif) and Day 2 (60 km, 3,200 m, Nant Gwynant to Dolgellau); Dragon's Tail covered 72 km, 3,200 m in the Bannau Brycheiniog followed by 65 km, 1,300 m to Cardiff.
Felix Buchner spent the longest time on course, finishing the full race in 88:57:34 and receiving the 'Daffy' the Dragon trophy.
